name: ugchooks
description: Turn a product link into TikTok and Reels posts with UGCHooks, then read back the hooks, slide text, captions and hashtags.

interface.shortDescription: TikTok and Reels posts from a product link
interface.longDescription: Create UGCHooks post batches from a product, website or app store link and read the brief, hooks, slideshow text, reaction-hook beats, meme captions, captions and hashtags. Write the remaining parts of batches you unlocked in the app. The connection never buys credits, unlocks batches or posts; publish through UGC API.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make a UGCHooks batch for my product link and show me the five strongest hooks.
